summary: Frontend-only regression for the redesigned Iron Man / Jarvis cinematic HUD. All 13 requested features pass end-to-end at desktop viewport 1920x1080. Boot -> activation auto-transition -> HUD opens cleanly. Dense layout confirmed: topbar (brand + telemetry + api-key), left rail (chat/log/state stream/status), core (tech-dials, reactor strips, spectrum, ReactorOrb, stats row), right rail (executive matrix, radar, SecondBrain), bottom command deck (input + send/mic/stop + seals). Chat input triggers simulated assistant response, mic/parar fala toggle the orb state text without crash, reactor orb click flips state, SecondBrain graph renders nodes, node modal opens/edits/deletes/adds/resets successfully. No horizontal overflow, no console errors, no React runtime errors. AI features (Claude / STT / TTS) remain MOCKED as declared in the request; skills ai-testing-core/llm not required this iteration.

issues: 'PRIMARY REACTOR' kicker text is visually clipped behind the top edge of the reactor-cluster (only 'IMARY REACTOR' peeks through); consider adding top padding to .stage-core-copy or lowering the reactor-cluster top offset so the kicker is fully readable.
'CENTRAL CORE / ESCUTA ATIVA' overlay sits directly on top of the reactor-bottom-spectrum bars, hurting readability; add a subtle background or shift the spectrum a few px down.

Under the graph, the 'Relações / Sistema' legend row and the 'contexto injetado' green pill are pushed slightly below the visible fold at 1080p (same issue reported in iteration_1). Tightening brain-panel vertical spacing so the legend stays inside the visible area would improve polish.

action_items: Optional: lift .stage-core-copy above reactor-cluster so 'PRIMARY REACTOR' kicker is not clipped.
Optional: adjust reactor-bottom-spectrum / CENTRAL CORE label so text does not overlap the spectrum bars.
Optional (carried from iter_1): reduce vertical spacing inside SecondBrain dock so legend + context pill stay above the fold at 1080p.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is now ~552 lines (down from ~984) with sub-components split into /jarvisPreview/*. Good progress on the 700-line guideline.

TechDial / MetricPanel / DataColumn are declared in App.js but only used inside the HUD - fine for now, but if they are reused elsewhere consider moving them to /jarvisPreview/components/ for consistency.

sampleResponse is imported from constants and used in a setTimeout inside sendCommand; no cleanup on unmount for these nested setTimeouts - low risk in this preview, but worth guarding once phases can be exited.
seed_data_creation: none - preview uses in-memory + localStorage defaults
